newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end down on Jinan Qingqi.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end down on Jinan Qingqi.

text.p: Shanghai B shares ended down on Tuesday with market sentiment hurt by the unsatisfactory performance of newly-listed Jinan Qingqi Motorcycle Co 900946.SS and falls on the A share market, brokers said.
The B index fell 1.512 points or 1.77 percent to 83.707 points on volume of 47.603 million shares worth $28.467 million.
Jinan Qingqi's 230 million B shares listed today ended the session at an intraday low of $0.550, compared with an issue price of $0.482.

"Qingqi's listing made most investors offset their positions in other shares to speculate in the newcomer, which pushed the market down," said one broker. "Falls among the A shares also hurt market sentiment."
Shares are not included in the index calculations on their first day of listing.

"Most investors were disappointed at Jinan Qingqi's unpromising performance today," another broker said. "The market's short-term outlook is not optimistic due to a lack of fresh capital and instability in the A share market."
Of 44 B shares, 40 traded, with 25 down, five flat and 10 up.
Shanghai Yaohua Pilkington Glass was the biggest loser on position-adjusting selling, plunging $0.038 or 8.63 percent to $0.402 on volume of 389,700 shares.

Shanghai Lujiazui Finance and Trade Zone Development was the second most actively traded following Jinan Qingqi, falling $0.036 or 2.46 percent to $1.422 on a technical correction on volume of 937,800 shares.
Shanghai's A share index moved down after gains over the past few trading days with recent spate of listings and issues sucking large amounts of capital out of the secondary market, brokers said.
They said the market was also affected by investor concerns over the detailed measures to be introduced under which state firms will be banned from speculating in stocks, expected soon.
The index closed down 16.010 points or 1.22 percent to 1,301.122 points on volume of 305.8 million shares worth 4.0 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index fell 40.159 points or 1.04 percent to 3,839.624 points.
Xinjiang Hops was the biggest loser on profit-taking, slumping 1.16 yuan or 10.00 percent to 10.44 yuan on volume of 4.1 million shares.
